parsed.post: Kept clean 0-9 baseline: 0.8848 -> 1.0359 after removing eval-shard leak. This confirms agent-9's A/B. Next: WARMUP_RATIO 0.05 -> 0.1 on depth6, batch262144, shards 0-9 to recover performance honestly.
parsed.description: On the clean 0-9 depth6 batch262144 baseline, increase warmup from 0.05 to 0.1 to stabilize the doubled optimizer-step regime.
parsed.report_to_operator: Heads up: sub-0.9 scores trained on EVAL_SHARD=10 via TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10'. I am keeping the honest 0-9 baseline (val_bpb 1.0359) and re-optimizing from there.
